model: Re-condensing (zero boil-off) cryostat for CCC and Josephson array inserts
family: pulse-tube re-condensing liquid-helium bath cryostat for metrology inserts (CCC, PJVS)
description: Zero-boil-off cryostat with a Cryomech PT405 pulse tube (0.5 W at 4.2 K) that liquefies helium gas from a room-temperature cylinder into a pressure-stabilised ~5 L LHe reservoir at 4 K; 3 inch (76.2 mm) bore for a cryogenic current comparator or Josephson array insert; 50 K radiation shield; >250 mW absorbable at 4.2 K.

Cryocooled cryostat for use with CCC/Josephson array inserts (Cryogenic Limited flyer)

configurations.name: Re-condensing CCC/JVS cryostat with PT405 pulse tube, 76.2 mm bore (cryostat only, insert not included)
configurations.configuration_basis: Standard re-condensing cryostat with PT405 pulse-tube cryocooler and compressor; the CCC or Josephson array insert and the Lake Shore controller are NOT counted (sample wiring belongs to the insert). Helium gas cylinder (10 m3, 99.998 %) supplied by the client.

unknowns.why: Sub-mK control needs 'A lakeshore temperature controller [that] can be used'. The configuration basis says the Lake Shore controller is NOT counted, so the stability cannot be listed as installed.
